claim: Aravis does not implement GigE Vision action commands: the GVCP command enum has no ACTION_CMD; only capability bit and ACTION_LATE status codes exist. Feature request #184 open since 2018; draft PR #468 (2021) open and unimplemented.

arv_buffer_get_timestamp returns the device's 64-bit GVSP leader timestamp converted to ns using the bootstrap TimestampTickFrequency registers (falls back to host time if tick frequency is 0); arv_buffer_get_system_timestamp is host g_get_real_time()*1000 at leader-packet arrival.
